policy_name: Vanguard Financial Controls and Segregation of Duties Policy

strict_invariants.description: The AI reconciliation agent is an analytical engine only. It must never silently alter or delete general ledger or accounts payable records.
The AI agent must never initiate, authorize, or claim execution of cash disbursements, ACH transfers, or wire transfers.
All calculations for line totals, variances, remaining balances, and summaries must match independent arithmetic ground truth.
